description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 dbtell: the definition of the database as the standard configuration of the installation holds it (the ontologies chebi, eco, edam, edam_data, edam_format, edam_identifier, edam_operation, edam_topic, go, go_component, go_function, go_process, pw, ro, so, swo, the data resource catalogue drcat and the taxonomy taxon): the file that defines it, the access levels (id, query, all), the attributes; an alias (any case other than the lower case name) is reported as such; a name that only the DRCAT catalogue defines (embl, uniprot, pdb ...) gives the line 'defined in DRCAT'; any other name gives no output. The databases of a user configuration file (.embossrc) and of a server (-server) are not read. Equals the installed program on 302 runs (standard output, error stream, exit status and written files byte for byte). B09 WP67, F309.

database.description: The name of the database (any case), e.g. go_process, drcat, EMBL.

full.description: Verbose output (-full): the aliases of the database follow its definition.

text.description: The text the program writes to standard output.

files.description: The other files the program wrote, by name (none).

messages.description: What the library printed on the error stream (warnings and errors).

errors.message: The program died: the messages of the library (a value it refuses)

examples.name: A run on the standard configuration

output.text:
# go_process is defined in standard
# access levels id: Yes query: Yes all: Yes

DBNAME go_process [
   format:         "obo"
   method:         "emboss"
   type:           "obo"
   comment:        "Gene Ontology (biological processes)"
   directory:      "/usr/share/EMBOSS/data/OBO"
   field:          "id ! identifier without the prefix"
   field:          "acc ! full name and any alternate identifier(s)"
   field:          "nam ! words in the name"
   field:          "isa ! parent identifier from is_a relation(s)"
   field:          "des ! words in the description"
   field:          "ns ! namespace"
   indexdirectory: "/usr/share/EMBOSS/index"
   namespace:      "biological_process"
   release:        "1.1.3300"
   edamdat:        "0966 ! Ontology term"
   edamfmt:        "2196 ! OBO format"
   edamid:         "1176 ! GO term ID"
   edamtpc:        "0089 ! Ontologies"
   taxon:          "1 all"
]
